1.text: Hanyuma y'ibyo Yesu ajya hakurya y'Inyanja y'i Galilaya, ari yo yitwa Tiberiya.

2.text: Iteraniro ry'abantu benshi riramukurikira, kuko babonye ibimenyetso yakoreye abarwayi.

3.text: Yesu azamuka umusozi yicaranayo n'abigishwa be.

4.text: Ubwo Pasika, iminsi mikuru y'Abayuda, yendaga gusohora.

5.text: Yesu yubura amaso, abonye abantu benshi baza aho ari abaza Filipo ati “Turagura hehe ibyokurya ngo aba babone ibyo barya?”

6.text: Icyatumye amubaza atyo yagira ngo amugerageze, ubwe yari azi icyo ari bukore.

7.text: Filipo aramusubiza ati “Imitsima yagurwa idenariyo magana abiri ntiyabakwira, nubwo umuntu yaryaho gato.”

8.text: Umwe mu bigishwa be, ari we Andereya mwene se wa Simoni Petero aramubwira ati

9.text: “Hano hari umuhungu ufite imitsima itanu y'ingano, n'ifi ebyiri. Ariko ibyo byamarira iki abantu bangana batya?”

10.text: Yesu ati “Nimwicaze abantu.” Aho hantu hari ubwatsi bwinshi, nuko abagabo baricara, bari nk'ibihumbi bitanu.

11.text: Yesu yenda ya mitsima arayishimira ayigabanya abicaye, n'ifi na zo azigenza atyo nk'uko bazishakaga.

12.text: Bamaze guhaga abwira abigishwa be ati “Nimuteranye ubuvungukira busigaye hatagira ikintu gipfa ubusa.”

13.text: Barateranya buzuza intonga cumi n'ebyiri z'ubuvungukira bwa ya mitsima itanu y'ingano, ubwo abariye bashigaje.

14.text: Abantu babonye ikimenyetso yakoze baravuga bati “Ni ukuri uyu ni we wa muhanuzi wari ukwiriye kuza mu isi.”

15.text: Yesu amenye yuko bagiye kuza kumufata ngo bamwimike, arabiyufūra asubira ku musozi wenyine.

16.text: Bugorobye abigishwa be baramanuka bajya ku nyanja.

17.text: Bikira mu bwato, bambuka inyanja bagana i Kaperinawumu. Bwari bwije kandi na Yesu atarabageraho,

19.text: Bamaze kuvugama sitadiyo makumyabiri n'eshanu cyangwa mirongo itatu, babona Yesu agendesha amaguru hejuru y'inyanja. Ageze bugufi bw'ubwato baratinya.

21.text: Baherako bemera ko ajya mu bwato, uwo mwanya bugera imusozi aho bajyaga.

22.text: Bukeye bwaho iteraniro ry'abantu benshi ryari rihagaze hakurya y'inyanja, bamenya yuko hari ubwato bumwe gusa kandi ko Yesu atīkiranye n'abigishwa be muri bwo, ahubwo ko bagiye bonyine ubwabo.

23.text: Nuko ayandi mato avuye i Tiberiya amaze kwambuka, afata bugufi bw'aho barīriye ya mitsima, Umwami Yesu amaze kuyishimira.

24.text: Nuko abo bantu babonye ko Yesu n'abigishwa be badahari, bikira muri ayo mato ubwabo bajya i Kaperinawumu kumushakirayo.

25.text: Bamubonye hakurya y'inyanja baramubaza bati “Mwigisha, waje hano ryari?”

26.text: Yesu arabasubiza ati “Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndababwira yuko ibimenyetso mwabonye atari byo bituma munshaka, ahubwo ni ya mitsima mwariye mugahaga.

27.text: Ntimukorere ibyokurya bishira, ahubwo mukorere ibyokurya bigumaho kugeza ku bugingo buhoraho, ibyo Umwana w'umuntu azabaha, kuko Se ari we Mana yamushyizeho ikimenyetso cyayo.”

28.text: Baramubaza bati “Tugire dute ngo dukore imirimo y'Imana?”

29.text: Arabasubiza ati “Umurimo w'Imana nguyu: ni uko mwizera uwo yatumye.”

30.text: Baramubaza bati “Urakora kimenyetso ki ngo tukirebe tukwizere? Icyo wakora ni iki?

31.text: Ba sogokuruza bacu barīraga manu mu butayu, nk'uko byanditswe ngo ‘Yabahaye kurya umutsima uvuye mu ijuru.’ ”

32.text: Yesu arababwira ati “Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndababwira yuko Mose atari we wabahaye umutsima uvuye mu ijuru, ahubwo ni Data ubaha umutsima w'ukuri uvuye mu ijuru.

33.text: Kuko umutsima w'Imana ari umanuka uva mu ijuru, ugaha abari mu isi ubugingo.”

34.text: Baramubwira bati “Databuja, ujye uduha uwo mutsima iteka.”

35.text: Yesu arababwira ati “Ni jye mutsima w'ubugingo, uza aho ndi ntazasonza na hato, n'unyizera ntabwo azagira inyota na hato.

36.text: Ariko nababwiye yuko mwambonye, nyamara ntimwizera.

37.text: Uwo Data yampaye wese aza aho ndi, kandi uza aho ndi sinzamwirukana na hato.

38.text: Kuko ntavanywe mu ijuru no gukora ibyo nishakiye, ahubwo nazanywe no gukora ibyo uwantumye ashaka,

39.text: kandi ibyo uwantumye ashaka ni ibi: ni ukugira ngo mu byo yampaye byose ntagira na kimwe nzimiza, ahubwo ngo nzakizure ku munsi w'imperuka.

40.text: Kuko icyo Data ashaka ari iki: ni ukugira ngo umuntu wese witegereza Umwana akamwizera ahabwe ubugingo buhoraho, nanjye nzamuzure ku munsi w'imperuka.”

41.text: Nuko Abayuda baramwitotombera kuko yavuze ati “Ni jye mutsima wavuye mu ijuru.”

42.text: Bati “Uyu si we Yesu mwene Yosefu, ntituzi se na nyina? Ni iki gituma avuga ko yavuye mu ijuru?”

44.text: Nta wubasha kuza aho ndi, keretse arehejwe na Data wantumye, nanjye nkazamuzura ku munsi w'imperuka.

45.text: Byanditswe mu byahanuwe ngo ‘Bose bazigishwa n'Imana.’ Umuntu wese wumvise ibya Data akabyiga aza aho ndi.

46.text: Si ukugira ngo hari umuntu wabonye Data, keretse uwavuye ku Mana, uwo ni we wabonye Data.

47.text: Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndababwira yuko uwizera ari we ufite ubugingo buhoraho.

49.text: Ba sekuruza wanyu barīraga manu mu butayu, nyamara barapfuye.

50.text: Uyu ni wo mutsima umanuka uva mu ijuru, kugira ngo umuntu uwurya ye gupfa.

51.text: Ni jye mutsima muzima wavuye mu ijuru. Umuntu narya uwo mutsima azabaho iteka ryose, kandi umutsima nzatanga ku bw'abari mu isi kugira ngo babone ubugingo, ni umubiri wanjye.”

52.text: Abayuda bajya impaka bati “Mbese uyu yabasha ate kuduha umubiri we ngo tuwurye?”

53.text: Yesu arababwira ati “Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndababwira yuko nimutarya umubiri w'Umwana w'umuntu, ntimunywe n'amaraso ye, nta bugingo muba mufite muri mwe.

54.text: Urya umubiri wanjye, akanywa amaraso yanjye aba afite ubugingo buhoraho, nanjye nzamuzura ku munsi w'imperuka,

55.text: kuko umubiri wanjye ari ibyokurya by'ukuri, n'amaraso yanjye ari ibyokunywa by'ukuri.

56.text: Urya umubiri wanjye, akanywa amaraso yanjye, aguma muri jye nanjye nkaguma muri we.

57.text: Nk'uko Data uhoraho yantumye, nanjye nkaba ndiho ku bwa Data, ni ko undya na we azabaho ku bwanjye.

58.text: Uyu ni wo mutsima wavuye mu ijuru, si nk'uwo ba sekuruza banyu bariye bagapfa, ahubwo urya uyu mutsima azabaho iteka ryose.”

59.text: Ibyo yabivugiye mu isinagogi, yigishiriza i Kaperinawumu.

60.text: Nuko benshi mu bigishwa be babyumvise baravuga bati “Iryo jambo rirakomeye, ushobora kuryihanganira ni nde?”

61.text: Yesu amenya mu mutima we yuko abigishwa be babyitotombeye, arababaza ati “Mbese ibyo bibabereye igisitaza?

62.text: None mwabona Umwana w'umuntu azamuka ajya aho yahoze mbere byamera bite?

63.text: Umwuka ni we utanga ubugingo, umubiri nta cyo umaze. Amagambo mbabwiye ni yo mwuka, kandi ni yo bugingo,

64.text: ariko hariho bamwe muri mwe batizera.” (Kuko uhereye mbere na mbere Yesu yari azi abatizera abo ari bo, n'uzamugambanira uwo ari we.)

65.text: Nuko aravuga ati “Ni cyo cyatumye mbabwira yuko hatariho ubasha kuza aho ndi, keretse abihawe na Data.”

66.text: Benshi mu bigishwa be bahera ubwo basubira inyuma, barorera kugendana na we.

67.text: Yesu abaza abigishwa be cumi na babiri ati “Kandi namwe murashaka kugenda?”

68.text: Simoni Petero aramusubiza ati “Databuja, twajya kuri nde, ko ari wowe ufite amagambo y'ubugingo buhoraho,

69.text: natwe tukaba twizeye tuzi yuko uri Kristo, Uwera w'Imana?”

70.text: Yesu arabasubiza ati “Mbese si jye wabitoranyirije uko muri cumi na babiri? None dore umwe muri mwe ni umwanzi.”

71.text: Uwo yavugaga ni Yuda Isikariyota mwene Simoni kuko ari we wari ugiye kuzamugambanira, ari umwe muri abo cumi na babiri.
